Our client is an innovative SME located in the Maldegem region, specialising in the design, development and installation of high-tech test and measurement equipment for the agricultural sector. Their tailor-made solutions are used worldwide by machine manufacturers, universities and testing centres to accurately test, measure and optimise agricultural machinery. By combining engineering, machine building and automation, they deliver customised projects for customers across the globe.

Jobomschrijving

As a Project Engineer Machine Building, you will be involved in the complete development of innovative machines and testing systems. From the initial concept to the final installation at the customer's site, you will play an active role throughout the entire project lifecycle. This is a varied position combining engineering, assembly, testing and international commissioning.

As a Project Engineer Machine Building, your responsibilities include:

• Developing and improving new machines and technical solutions.
• Building, assembling and testing prototypes.
• Installing, commissioning and fine-tuning equipment at customer sites both nationally and internationally.
• Analysing technical issues and proposing improvements to products and processes.
• Preparing technical documentation, manuals and work instructions.
• Collaborating closely with colleagues from engineering, production and service departments.
• Providing technical support during demonstrations, trade fairs and commercial activities.

For this positFor this position as Project Engineer Machine Building, we are looking for an all-round engineer who enjoys combining theory with hands-on technical work. You like taking ownership of projects from start to finish and are willing to travel internationally on a regular basis.

As a Project Engineer Machine Building, you have:

• A Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electromechanics, Mechanical Engineering, Product Development, Machine Building or a related technical field.
• A strong interest in machine building, automation and product development.
• A hands-on mentality and practical approach to engineering.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
• Willingness to travel internationally for installations and commissioning projects.
• A good command of English.
• Knowledge of Dutch is mandatory.
• A valid Category B driving licence.

As a production worker, you're the driving force behind the production process. You ensure the production line always runs smoothly by replenishing and trimming meat as needed. Don't worry if you don't have experience with knives – you'll learn! You'll also help load and unload trucks and work in various departments, such as production, packaging, and shipping. No two days are the same for a production worker, and that's what makes it so rewarding.
We're looking for a production worker who's a hands-on person.

You're physically fit, speak fluent Dutch or English, and enjoy working independently and as part of a team. As a production worker, you take responsibility, remain calm under pressure, and prioritize effectively.

Flexibility is key: you'll start between 3:30 and 6:30 a.m. and work until everything is finished, OR you'll work in two shifts: from 3:30 a.m. to 1:30 p.m. and the other week from 1:30 p.m. to 10:30 p.m.

Working in a refrigerated environment? No problem for you!

 

Eager to get stuck in? Then you're the production worker we want on our team!

Where Italian nostalgia meets real hospitality leadership
 

Nando isn't just another restaurant, it's Nonna's kitchen, brought to life in Wilrijk, Antwerp. Retro details, honest Italian comfort food, and a room that feels like family. We're looking for a 
Waiter / Service Responsible to own the floor: someone who leads by example during service, keeps the room running like clockwork, and makes sure every guest leaves feeling like they just had dinner at home.
 

What you'll do
 
 

• Welcome guests and set the tone for the evening 

• Take orders and serve with precision, even when it's slammed 

• Own the floor during service — pace, table turns, team energy, guest happiness 

• Coach and steady the team in real time; step in and solve problems before guests notice them 

• Be the calm, capable presence management can count on when it gets busy  

What you bring
 
 

• Experience as a waiter or shift leader in hospitality 

• A natural feel for service and a bit of leadership instinct 

• Composure under pressure — busy nights don't rattle you 

• Organized, hands-on, solutions over excuses 

• English (required), basic Dutch (required); Italian or French is a real plus  

What's in it for you
 
 

• Full-time, 38h contract 

• €16.00–€18.00 brutto/hour, negotiable based on experience 

• Meal vouchers, holiday pay, and a 13th month 

• Bike allowance and uniform provided 

• Real responsibility on the floor from day one — with a clear path to become manager within your first 6 to 12 months 

• Room to grow within a restaurant group that's expanding  

Restaurant is open 7/7, with 2 days off per week.
 

 Send your CV, a photo, and a short intro to 
hr@lvpgroup.be — tell us why Nando feels like your kind of room.

“ 
We make it possible” is not just a slogan, it is our mission. Our growth is driven by our expertise and commitment, within an organization that values diversity and equal opportunities.
 

As part of the development of our activities in Belgium and the Netherlands, we are looking for an Administrative and Finance Officer to strengthen our administrative and financial team. You will work closely with the Director of Administration & Development in Belgium and actively contribute to financial monitoring and performance analysis, supporting both local teams and management in Belgium and France.
 

We invest in your professional development and in recognizing your financial expertise. Together, we are building a future of innovation, reliability, and team spirit.
 

Profile:
 

As an Administrative and Finance Officer, you provide essential administrative support to the Director and ensure the smooth day-to-day running of the company’s administration.
 

In this versatile and hands-on role, you will be responsible for various aspects of the company’s administration. You ensure that information is accurate, documents are up to date and files are properly followed up. You enjoy bringing order and structure to information and quickly identifying errors or missing elements.
 

You are meticulous, flexible and motivated to contribute to the development of a fast-growing company.
 

Your responsibilities :
 
 

• Manage and follow up on the company’s general administration 

• Check, process and follow up on invoices and payments 

• Monitor and update financial data and cost centres 

• Prepare and update various reports and tracking tools 

• Check, structure and maintain Excel files and other administrative documents 

• Organise and improve existing administrative data and tools 

• Provide administrative support for commercial activities and sales 

• Provide administrative support to the Director in the development of the company and on various projects 

• Prepare, collect and structure the information required by the Director 

• Follow up on various administrative actions and ensure deadlines are met  

In our small company with a straightforward organisational structure, this role is deliberately broad and varied. You are a trusted person who ensures that the company’s administration is well organised and who actively contributes to structuring and improving its day-to-day operations.

What you bring :
 
 

• Degree in accounting, business administration, management or a similar field 

• Excellent command of French, Dutch and English, both written and spoken 

• Good knowledge of Excel and an interest in analysing financial data 

• Analytical mindset, strong attention to detail and excellent organisational skills 

• Ability to work independently while collaborating closely with management

ICTS is the trusted partner for trailer rental, fleet maintenance and repairs, field services, and 24/7 roadside assistance. The company provides customers with a complete, worry-free solution for maintenance, servicing, breakdown support, and other on-road services. To strengthen its team, ICTS is looking for an Operations Manager.
 

Ready to take on responsibility within a growing international company? Then you might be the one that we are looking for!
 

JOB DESCRIPTION
 
 

• Leading, coaching and supporting the operational teams in Belgium, the Netherlands and Poland. 

• Organising and overseeing daily operations and rental planning in close cooperation with the workshops. 

• Monitoring the availability and quality of the trailer fleet, including correct inspections at handover and return. 

• Ensuring professional customer service, accurate administration and the proper follow-up of damage cases. 

• Monitoring operational KPI’s, resolving bottlenecks and implementing improvements where needed. 

• Promoting effective cooperation between operations, workshops and administration. 

PROFILE
 
 

• Proven experience in a supervisory or management role within an operational environment, preferably in transport, logistics or a technical sector. 

• A higher education qualification or an equivalent level gained through experience, combined with strong planning and organisational skills. 

• Clear communication, a coaching approach and the confidence to make decisions. 

• A customer-focused, proactive and solution-oriented mindset, even under pressure. 

• Good knowledge of MS Office and the ability to learn new software quickly. 

• Excellent command of Dutch and English, both written and spoken.

Following comprehensive in-house training, you will work independently with a variety of sheet metal processing machines. You will manufacture and process metal components according to technical drawings and ensure a high-quality finish for every part.

Your responsibilities include:

• Operating and setting up various sheet metal processing machines.

• Performing cutting and bending operations based on technical drawings.

• Calculating flat patterns and preparing production parts.

• Processing metal components through bending, cutting, punching, tapping, and grinding.

• Performing semi-automatic welding when required.

• Inspecting finished products for quality and dimensional accuracy.

• Ensuring compliance with safety and quality procedures.

• You hold an A2 degree in Mechanics or have equivalent experience.

• You have experience with a guillotine shear, press brake, corner notching machine, and punching machine.

• You can read and accurately interpret technical drawings.

• You possess strong spatial awareness and technical insight.

• You work accurately, independently, and with a strong focus on quality.

• You follow safety and quality procedures diligently.

• Good knowledge of Dutch or English is sufficient.

You will support the Map and Tariff team which is responsible for the digital map that is used in the final product.

You support the team in correct and accurate representation of geo information in the databases. 

This includes below activities: 

 
• Map Modelling: utilizing map editing tools such as ArcGIS Pro and QGIS to make changes to the digital map. 
This might involve adding new features, modifying existing ones, or deleting outdated or incorrect information. 
 
• Assisting the team in various GIS and data analyses. 
 
• Creating routine reports using the report creating tools 
 
• Documentation

 

 
• You have a bachelor's or master's degree in one of the following fields: Geography, Bio-engineering, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or Electromechanical Engineering 
 
• You have a passion for maps and IT 
 
• Ideally you are experienced in using a GIS Editing tool: ArcMap, ArcGIS Pro (ESRI) or QGIS 
 
• SQL, object-oriented programming and FME knowledge are a plus 
 
• You are fluent in English

jobs.occupation: S/4HANA Implementation Support Specialist - Drive digital transformation in a cloud environment
jobs.description:
Ready to use your SAP expertise in a project that makes a real impact? This is your opportunity to play a key role in a major digital transformation within an international organization that is investing heavily in innovation, technology, and process optimization.

We are looking for a temporary reinforcement to support the implementation of SAP S/4HANA Cloud. You will join a forward-thinking environment where your contribution will directly influence the success of an important digitalization project.

Your responsibilities

As an S/4HANA Implementation Support Specialist, you will help ensure a smooth and successful implementation process by:

• Supporting the rollout of SAP S/4HANA Cloud across the organization

• Assisting in the optimization and digitalization of business processes

• Providing support to end users and answering system-related questions

• Executing test scenarios and documenting findings

• Analyzing workflows and identifying opportunities for improvement

• Collaborating with internal stakeholders and external partners

• Creating and maintaining process documentation and user guidelines

• Contributing to a seamless transition toward the new ERP environment

In short, this is a varied position where you can make a tangible contribution to a high-impact transformation project.

We are seeking a proactive professional who can quickly adapt to a dynamic project environment and enjoys improving processes.

• Hands-on experience with SAP S/4HANA is essential

• Familiarity with cloud-based ERP systems

• Fluent communication skills in English

• Previous experience in ERP implementation, digital transformation, or system migration projects

• Strong analytical and problem-solving mindset

• Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail

• Ability to work independently while maintaining strong collaboration with colleagues

• An understanding of business processes in sales, operations, or administration is a plus

You do not need to know everything already, but a solid SAP foundation and a willingness to learn are key to succeeding in this role.

jobs.occupation: CE Dump Truck Driver – Reliable Shuttle Between Sint-Katelijne-Waver & Hemiksem
jobs.description:
As a CE Dump Truck Driver (m/f/x), you are responsible for daily shuttle transport between Sint-Katelijne-Waver and Hemiksem. You operate a tipper truck to ensure goods are loaded, transported, and unloaded safely and correctly. Safety, punctuality, and a strong sense of responsibility are key in this role.

Your average workday begins with a vehicle inspection. You load materials, depart on time to the next location, and ensure smooth delivery. In addition to transporting goods, you handle transport documents correctly and comply with driving and rest time regulations. You keep your truck clean and well-maintained. After your shift, you may take the truck home.

Can you see yourself driving between these two fixed sites for a reliable client? Apply today and secure a stable, well-paid job with future prospects!

• You have a valid CE driving license

• You are up to date with Code 95 and medical examination

• Experience with tipper transport is a plus, not a must

• You are punctual, reliable, and able to work independently

• You have a strong sense of responsibility

• You speak and understand basic Dutch or English

• You have at least lower secondary education

• 0 to 5 years of experience is sufficient

• Both junior and medior profiles are welcome
